LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 6.3.1 FUTURE TIME (WILL/SHALL)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Language Use 6.3.1 Future time (will/shall)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 6.3.1 Future time (will/shall), part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: Which words would you use to talk about things that will happen tomorrow or later?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 6.3.1 Future time (will/shall) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: Signing skills as the learner asks and answers questions using words that express future time.

Values:
Love: Self-sacrifice is emphasised as the learner assists others in sentence construction using will/shall.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Self-esteem as the learner gains confidence in using will/shall in when communicating.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Future time is emphasized in environmental activities and Mathematical Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as Hearing aids and amplifiers, charts showing words with the target letter sounds, flash cards
